name: Audora
long_description:
Audora turns your book or story into an audiobook where every character has their own voice.

The best adaptation of a book is the one in your head. You can see the characters in front of you and hear them talking to each other. We want an audiobook to do those characters justice: a voice that fits each of them, so a conversation actually sounds like a conversation.

Paste a story link or upload a file. Audora works out who’s speaking and gives each character a distinct voice alongside the narrator. You can start listening while the rest of the book is still being made.

Our roots are in fanfiction. We’re building for readers who already know these characters by heart, with a focus on voices that capture their personalities and stay consistent throughout the story.

Try Audora: https://audora.art
Watch the demo: https://youtu.be/R6Pt2O0fD4c
one_liner: Audiobooks where every character has their own voice.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
At eight, I started learning to code to become an ethical hacker. That led to security research, CTFs, and building for the Minecraft and fanfiction communities I grew up in.

I built Python and Rust libraries with 65,000+ downloads and a fanfiction platform that reached a million views in a month. At eighteen, I joined YC straight out of high school as Audora’s solo founder.

Now I’m building audiobooks that sound like the story in your head, with a distinct voice for every character.

launches.title: ⭐️ Audora 🎧 | Audiobooks where every character has their own voice
launches.body:
Think of the last book you couldn’t put down. You didn’t just read it. You heard it. The hero’s laugh. The villain’s quiet threat. Audora (YC F26) turns that voice in your head into something real: any book or story, as a ready-to-listen audiobook where every character has a voice of their own.

Most stories will never be heard. Professional narration costs hundreds of dollars per hour, so most books never get an audiobook at all. Authors lose listeners. Readers lose stories.

[media.audora.art/launch.mp4](http://media.audora.art/launch.mp4)

And the audiobooks that do exist? They were always a great idea in theory. In practice, it’s one voice reading every part, and the characters never sound like the ones you imagined. So we’re reinventing audiobooks from scratch, with real voices, better playback real performances, and some actual fun and taste put back in.

Paste a link or drop in a file, and Audora casts the whole story. The narrator pulls you into the scene. The villain sounds like someone you shouldn’t trust. The love interest sounds like someone worth waiting for. It stops feeling like you’re being read to, and starts feeling like you’re in the room. Any story, ready to play, more gripping than ever.

I’m Dhanush, and I’ve been building toward this for a long time. I started coding at 8. By the time I left school, I’d uncovered security flaws affecting tens of thousands of accounts and built Python and Rust libraries with 65,000+ downloads. At 16, I built a fanfiction platform that hit a million visits in a month. But it was always the stories that pulled me back. I wanted to hear the characters I’d spent years imagining. So straight out of high school, at 18, I joined YC to build Audora, with 10,000 readers and authors already on the waitlist.

Paste a story link at [audora.art](http://audora.art). Your first preview is free, no account needed.
